card.fact_statement: Abu Hassan al-Hamwi is the head of HTS's military wing.
card.source_span: According to Abu Hassan al-Hamwi, head of HTS's military wing, the offensive had been planned for a year prior to its launch.

target_qa_variants.question: ใครดำรงตำแหน่งหัวหน้าปีกทหารของ HTS?
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: อาบู ฮัสซัน อัลฮัมวี
target_qa_variants.source_span: According to Abu Hassan al-Hamwi, head of HTS's military wing, the offensive had been planned for a year prior to its launch.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'military wing' to 'ปีกทหาร' (commonly used in Thai news for political/military groups) and transliterated the Arabic name to Thai. Kept the acronym HTS as it is standard in Thai reporting.
